entries.keywords: wash hands handwashing germs soap hygiene steps
entries.a: Wash your hands with soap and clean water for about 20 seconds: wet, soap, rub palms, backs, between fingers and thumbs, rinse, dry. Do it before eating and after the toilet.

entries.keywords: balanced diet healthy food eat nutrition vitamins
entries.a: A balanced diet has energy foods (sadza, rice), body-building foods (beans, meat, eggs, fish), and protective foods (fruits and vegetables). Drink clean water every day.

entries.keywords: saving money budget save spend needs wants
entries.a: Saving tips: separate needs (food, school) from wants (sweets, toys), save a little each week, and set a goal. Small savings grow big!

entries.keywords: road safety cross street kombi traffic walk safe
entries.a: Road safety: stop at the kerb, look right, left, right again, listen, cross when clear and walk, never run. Use the pavement and never play on the road.

entries.keywords: internet online safety digital stranger password social media cyber
entries.a: Online safety: never share your name, school, address or password with strangers, tell a grown-up if something online makes you uncomfortable, and be kind online like you would in person.

entries.keywords: save water conserve environment drought tap clean
entries.a: Save water: close the tap while brushing, fix leaks, reuse washing water for plants. Always use clean, safe water for drinking.

entries.keywords: plant trees environment deforestation conservation climate
entries.a: Trees give us shade, fruit, clean air and stop soil erosion. Plant one, look after it, and do not cut trees for no reason.

entries.keywords: feelings emotions sad angry happy scared calm manners
entries.a: All feelings are okay. When you feel angry or sad: stop, breathe slowly, name the feeling, and talk to someone you trust. Be kind to yourself and others.
